note: Tropical realm at 78% forest cover, HUD, entities, fog and weather hidden; paused simulation; camera centred at the 0.95x rooftop level at midday. All twelve rainforest formations are real generated tiles, not hand-placed demo props. The seasonal strip follows an emergent stand through the wet-season flush, main fruiting pulse, dry-season peak and warm rainy season. Each tile records all 65 rainforest requirements, the three canopy strata, water, hazards, land use, goods and fauna. Not a GPU performance benchmark.
